description: Self-contained toggle block. Owns the header contenteditable JS lifecycle and manages child blocks (lazy-loaded from the aggregate-backed editor service). Arrow click fires OnOpenChanged so the parent can persist the new IsOpen state. Enter on an empty header fires OnTypeConvert("paragraph") to escape the toggle. Enter on a non-empty header fires OnEnterSplit to create a new sibling block after.

parameters.name: OnContentSaved
parameters.description: Fired on blur when header HTML has changed. Arg = new HTML.

parameters.name: OnDeleteRequested
parameters.description: Fired when Backspace is pressed on an empty header.

parameters.name: OnEnterSplit
parameters.description: Fired when Enter is pressed on a non-empty header. Arg = HTML after the split point.

parameters.name: OnMergeWithPrevious
parameters.description: Raised when Backspace is pressed at the start of a non-empty block. The payload is the block's current, sanitized HTML, which the previous block absorbs before this one is deleted.

parameters.name: OnStructuredPaste
parameters.description: Raised when pasted HTML carries more than one block element. The payload is the raw clipboard HTML; the consumer turns it into page blocks.

parameters.name: OnFocused
parameters.description: Fired when the header editable receives focus.

parameters.name: OnMentionMenu
parameters.type: EventCallback<(string BlockId, double Top, double Left)>
parameters.description: Fired when '@' is typed. Args = (blockId, top, left) caret coords.

parameters.name: OnOpenChanged
parameters.description: Fired when the open/closed state changes. Arg = new IsOpen value.

parameters.name: OnPageLinkMenu
parameters.type: EventCallback<(string BlockId, double Top, double Left)>
parameters.description: Fired when '[[' is typed. Args = (blockId, top, left) caret coords.

parameters.name: OnSlashMenu
parameters.type: EventCallback<(string BlockId, double Top, double Left)>
parameters.description: Fired when '/' is typed. Args = (blockId, top, left) caret coords.

parameters.name: OnTokenMenu
parameters.type: EventCallback<(string BlockId, double Top, double Left)>
parameters.description: Fired when '{{' token syntax is typed. Args = (blockId, top, left) caret coords.

parameters.name: OnTypeConvert
parameters.description: Fired when a markdown or conversion shortcut is detected. Special value "paragraph" means the user pressed Enter on an empty header.
